candidate_decisions.reason: The trusted channel nomination has a focus carrier in complaint, disclosed distress, and God-sourced knowledge, and the supplied 12:87 context supplies independent movement, sensory tracking, relief, hope, and truth-covering contrasts that materially turn the focus into a directed opening toward search.

The exact HFT trace connects two supplied focus forms with attributed contextual states of inward hiding, self-location, non-disclosure, and restraint; the directed focus object and addressee produce a materially changed selective-disclosure reading while the alternative separation of Yusuf's restraint remains visible.

The trace lands the reframed family-and-near-circle facet of grief, the dispersal facet of the focus object, and attributed fatherhood, covenant, prior failure, and gathering carriers; together they change private sorrow into accountable grief for a still-gatherable household.

The focus knowledge forms contact the supplied testimony, unseen-boundary, custody, and later ignorance contexts; the exact trace supports a distinct evidence-horizon reading rather than merely repeating that Jacob knows more.

The focus sign/marker facet meets exact pericope traces of severed hope, predicted wasting, going, sensory tracking, and relief; the resulting reading changes knowledge from consolation held inwardly into a warrant for concrete search, with nominated or unresolved context branches retained as attributed.

The exact trace places the focus knowledge between supplied bodily damage to the eyes and a later restoration of sight; this creates a distinct tension between knowing and seeing without displacing the ordinary knowledge claim.

The accusation and characterization contexts, the focus's inward-distress object, and the later no-reproach/forgiveness context jointly produce a distinct non-prosecutorial disclosure reading; moral legibility remains contained rather than erased.

The outlier has a supplied focus vessel facet, a supplied dispersal facet, and exact contextual restraint and relief contacts; its changed reading is materially distinct and is retained as an exploratory material analogy with the packet's explicit containment.

The focus supplies exact heart-irritation and moment/state facets, while the supplied remembrance and wasting contexts give a distinct repeated-reactivation mechanism; the packet's form-distance qualification is retained rather than used to suppress it.

findings.title: Complaint opens a directed search
findings.claim: Within the supplied pericope, the focus's complaint and God-sourced knowledge open into directed movement, sensory tracking, relief, and renewed hope.
findings.mechanism: The focus carries inward distress to God and states knowledge beyond the addressees; 12:87 then supplies going, active tracking, relief, and repeated prohibition of hopelessness, so disclosure and knowledge become an opening toward search rather than a terminal report.
findings.reader_payoff: The ayah becomes a hinge from voiced grief to an actionable field that remains open to traces.
findings.containment: This is a local pericope synthesis. Complaint remains complaint, knowledge remains a knowledge claim, and the contextual images do not establish a whole-surah system or replace the plain reading.

epistemic.reason: The channel source is trusted and the focus contacts are exact, while several contextual images are nominated source records rather than independent lexicon records.

findings.title: Selective directed release
findings.claim: The focus can be heard as a controlled transfer in which inwardly held pain is disclosed to God rather than circulated without direction.
findings.mechanism: The exact trace places inward hiding, self-location, non-disclosure, and restraint before the focus; the focus then names its own anguish and grief and fixes God as the destination, producing selective disclosure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the complaint is an opening with a boundary, not merely an emotional outpouring.
findings.containment: The 12:77 restraint belongs explicitly to Yusuf in the supplied evidence; the selective-transfer relation is an attributed contextual inference, not an assertion that both scenes are identical.

epistemic.reason: The focus contacts are lexically supplied, while the context carriers and their roles are legacy-unbound HFT attributions.

findings.title: Grief carried for a dispersed household
findings.claim: The focus's grief can also be heard as the burden of answerability carried by a father for a dispersed household whose gathering remains possible.
findings.mechanism: The family relations, binding pledge, remembered failure, and later gathering contacts meet the focus's grief and dispersal images; the household's broken configuration gives the sorrow a custodial and recoverable shape.
findings.reader_payoff: Grief becomes more than an inward state: it carries responsibility for people whose separation still has a possible reversal.
findings.containment: Personal bereavement remains intact. The custodial reading is a qualified contextual coloring, and the supplied gathering trajectory does not guarantee an outcome at the focus.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch is supplied and reframed, while contextual family and covenant carriers are legacy-unbound HFT attributions.

findings.title: A different horizon of knowing
findings.claim: The focus places God-given knowing within a horizon of signs that remains available where the brothers' witness-bound account reaches its boundary.

findings.containment: The packet leaves a live alternative of private hope without a distinct method of knowing; the horizon reading remains qualified and does not claim a complete theory of revelation.

epistemic.reason: Exact focus and context coordinates support the contrast, while all contextual branch records are legacy-unbound attributed evidence.

epistemic.reason: The focus branches are independently described, while the accusation and forgiveness carriers are legacy-unbound HFT attributions.

findings.title: A controlled pressure outlet
findings.claim: The focus can be pictured, by material analogy, as a full interior opening through a controlled outlet toward one recipient so its contents do not burst into indiscriminate spread.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies complaint, disclosed distress, and a fixed destination; the attributed context supplies a small vessel, held pressure, and relief after constriction, creating a contained-pressure circuit.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the directionality of the complaint as a physical relation of holding, opening, and relief.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory analogy, not a lexical equivalence between complaint and vessel; it remains anchored in the focus phrase and the supplied restraint/relief contacts.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace explicitly marks this as an outlier and supplies its containment; contextual branch records remain legacy-unbound.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: küçük deri su ya da süt kabı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel nesne, su veya süt taşımaya ayrılmış küçük bir deri kaptır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَشْكُوا۟ carries the focus act that receives the vessel analogy.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus's inward distress and fixed destination provide contents and outlet direction.
branch_activations.activation: Complaint contacts the attributed vessel image through its containing and directed function.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Complaint can be pictured as opening a contained interior toward a recipient.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus word does not literally denote a leather vessel in this reading.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dagitma, nesnenin ortaya cikmasi, yayilmasi, savrulmasi veya yerinden kaldirilip hareketlendirilmesi sonucunu dogurabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: بَثِّ carries a pressure that can spread once released.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The complaint act supplies the directed outlet that contains the release.
branch_activations.activation: The dispersal facet meets the vessel analogy and turns release into a boundary question.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Disclosure is controlled so inward pressure does not become indiscriminate spread.
branch_activations.boundary: No physical material or literal bursting is claimed.

branch_activations.carrier: The trace identifies 12:84:12 as the held-breath and restrained state.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Complaint and disclosed distress arrive as the focus's opening act.
branch_activations.activation: The attributed held state supplies the full interior before the controlled outlet opens.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's complaint has the shape of release after restraint.
branch_activations.boundary: No independent branch gloss is supplied for the restraint carrier.

branch_activations.facet_statement: rest, relief, ease, and repose
branch_activations.carrier: The repeated relief expression carries the release effect after constriction.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus supplies contained distress and a single directed outlet.
branch_activations.activation: Relief meets the outlet analogy as the result of opening pressure toward a recipient.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The complaint releases pressure while preserving direction.
branch_activations.boundary: The analogy does not claim that the focus promises complete emotional rest.

findings.title: Grief renewed as inner abrasion
findings.claim: Repeated remembrance can color the focus's grief as a fresh inner abrasion in each present moment, so continuity is produced by reactivation rather than emotional stasis.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies heart-irritation and moment/state facets; the preceding remembrance and wasting prediction supply repeated renewal and feared bodily accumulation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel why repeated remembering makes the grief active again rather than merely long-lasting.
findings.containment: The packet explicitly marks this as form-distant because it carries a secondary mapping into حزن; it is an exploratory texture, not the direct denotation of the grief noun.

epistemic.reason: The outlier trace is exact but explicitly exploratory and form-distant; its containment is preserved.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Öfke, keder ya da sitem kişinin içinde acı veren, kemirici bir rahatsızlık bırakır.
branch_activations.carrier: حُزْنِ carries the focus grief noun.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding remembrance occurrence supplies the repeated renewal of the missing one in mind.
branch_activations.activation: Grief meets remembrance as an action that reopens an inner abrasion.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The grief is felt as repeatedly renewed inward pain.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus remains ordinary grief; the abrasion is an exploratory texture.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: an, zaman ve içinde bulunulan durum
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir olayın gerçekleştiği an, saat veya zaman dilimi belirtilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus grief noun carries the moment/state facet in the outlier trace.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Remembrance and the predicted wasting divide the grief into successive present states.
branch_activations.activation: The time/state facet gives repeated remembrance a sequence of renewed impacts.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Continuity is heard as recurring activation across moments.
branch_activations.boundary: No chronological measurement is asserted.

branch_activations.carrier: The trace identifies 12:85:4 as bringing Yusuf back to mind.

branch_activations.activation: Repeated remembrance supplies the action that renews the focus abrasion.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Memory is an active re-entry into grief.
branch_activations.boundary: No independent branch gloss is supplied for the remembrance carrier.

branch_activations.carrier: The trace identifies 12:85:8 as the feared wasting toward destruction.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus grief supplies the inner condition that the prediction threatens to accumulate.
branch_activations.activation: The wasting forecast gives repeated abrasion a bodily limit and danger.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Renewed grief is heard against the fear of being consumed by it.
branch_activations.boundary: No independent branch gloss is supplied, and no outcome is asserted.

findings.title: Fātiḥa gives knowing an orienting edge
findings.claim: The explicitly added Fātiḥa path request gives the focus's knowing an additional local edge as a sign that orients movement, while the focus still states ordinary God-sourced knowledge.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier أَعْلَمُ meets the supplied marker/guidance facet through the external occurrence العٰلَمِينَ and the explicit request for guidance along the straight path in 1:6; the contact changes a private knowledge contrast into knowledge heard as orientation.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus's knowledge can be perceived as something that points and guides, not only as information withheld from the sons.
findings.containment: This is an external overlay limited to the listed Fātiḥa occurrences; it does not import a whole-surah path thesis or claim that every knowledge use is guidance.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and exact external context occurrences are supplied, but this overlay is a fresh writer inference beyond the candidate docket.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ayırt edici ve yol gösterici işaret
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi ve kumaşın kenar deseni yön bulduran veya tanıtan somut gerçekleşmelerdir.
branch_activations.carrier: أَعْلَمُ carries the focus knowing form at the return point.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: العَالَمِينَ supplies the external sign-bearing occurrence, and اهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَاطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ supplies explicit guidance and path direction.
branch_activations.activation: The focus knowing contacts the external waymark and guidance request, making orientation a specific added relation rather than a whole-Fātiḥa theme.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: God-sourced knowing is heard as an orienting sign that can lead action.
branch_activations.boundary: The overlay does not identify a physical sign in 12:86 or turn the focus into a recitation of 1:6.

findings.title: The named addressee within exclusive dependence
findings.claim: Fātiḥa's exclusive worship and help request adds a local relational edge to the two divine-name phrases in the focus: the destination of complaint and source of knowledge is the one worshipped and relied upon.
findings.mechanism: The focus carries Allah as the named destination and origin; 1:5 supplies the independent acts of worship and seeking help, activating the worshipped-being facet without changing the focus's complaint or knowledge acts.
findings.reader_payoff: The repeated divine name is heard as a relation of exclusive dependence rather than as a bare proper name alone.
findings.containment: The overlay does not turn the focus into 1:5 or make complaint identical with worship; it only colors the named recipient and source through the local external contact.

epistemic.reason: The named focus carrier, exact branch facet, and explicit 1:5 occurrences are supplied; the added relational effect is a bounded writer inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
branch_activations.carrier: The two Allah occurrences carry the named destination and named source of the focus acts.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The external 1:5 occurrences supply worship and seeking help directed exclusively to the divine addressee.
branch_activations.activation: The proper name in the focus contacts the worshipped-being facet through the external exclusive-dependence acts.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Complaint and knowledge are heard within a relation to the one worshipped and relied upon.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not become a second wording of 1:5, and no claim is made that every use of Allah activates this overlay.

friction_notes: All eight HFT records are legacy_unbound. Their exact focus traces are retained, while unresolved contextual branches use attributed application with null gloss and facet rather than an invented lexicon reading.
The packet supplies no semantic_obligations collection or required_branch_facets beyond the candidate branch lists; semantic_obligation_refs and exclusion arrays therefore remain empty.
Focus word alignment is complete at 15 of 15 words with no unresolved joins; context morphology is intentionally lean, so context carrier refs use supplied ayah-and-word coordinates.

The native pericope connections were reviewed without adding a separate uncandidate finding where their contribution was already carried by an accepted candidate finding. The external overlay phase admitted only the bounded 1:2/1:6 guidance contact and the 1:5 exclusive-dependence contact; host basmala 12:0 and external 1:3, 1:4, and 1:7 supplied no separate changed reading with a local focus contact, and no whole-Fatiha theme was imported.
